login.title: Welcome back
login.intro: Log in to see your requests and messages.

register.title: Create your account
register.intro: With an account you can follow your requests and reply to messages.
register.welcome: Welcome! Your account has been created.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter your email address. We'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {{email}}, you'll receive an email with a link within a few minutes. The link is valid for 1 hour.
forgot.unavailable: Password emails can't be sent at the moment. Please contact us and we'll help you.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.intro: Choose a new password. You'll then be logged out everywhere.
reset.success: Your password has been changed. You can now log in.
reset.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again or request a new one.
